item.text: [{"task_id":"30f42897","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['settings'][0]))","    zero = int(round(params['settings'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['settings'][2]))","    factor = int(round(params['settings'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    if zero < 0 or step <= zero or step >= min(h, w) or factor <= step:","        return out","    colors = np.unique(grid[grid != bg])","    if len(colors) != step:","        return out","    color = int(colors[zero])","    border = []","    for c in range(zero, w, step):","        border.append((zero, c))","    for r in range(step, h, step):","        border.append((r, w - step))","    for c in range(w - factor * step, zero - step, -step):","        border.append((h - step, c))","    for r in range(h - factor * step, zero, -step):","        border.append((r, zero))","    marked = [grid[r, c] == color for r, c in border]","    length = sum(marked)","    if length <= zero:","        return out","    starts = [i for i in range(len(border)) if marked[i] and not marked[(i - step) % len(border)]]","    if len(starts) != step:","        return out","    start = starts[zero]","    period = factor * length","    for i in range(len(border)):","        r, c = border[i]","        if (i - start) % period < length:","            out[r, c] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"settings":[4]},"params":{"settings":[8,0,1,2]},"rationale":"Treat the boundary as a clockwise cyclic sequence.
